title: pycreus pumilus var. patens
intro: Pycreus pumilus var. patens, commonly known as Dwarf Cumbungi, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pycreus pumilus var. patens include reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and soothing skin irritations. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions are still being researched, but they are believed to include compounds such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
